Gold, Silver, and Coins Worth Over Rs 47 Lakh Seized at Delhi Airport

Customs officials at Delhi's Indira Gandhi International Airport seized gold, silver, and coins valued at Rs 47.16 lakh. The seizure included 134 silver coins described as having archaeological significance and 484 silver coins. A gold coin was also recovered. The total value of the seized items is Rs 47.16 lakh.
